_meta.label: English
alerts.absent.none.msg: No active public alert right now. The server is not broadcasting any urgent communication. Keep using the app as usual.
alerts.absent.none.title: No active alert
alerts.absent.offline.msg: You are offline — unable to check the status of alerts or updates. Try again when you are back online.
alerts.absent.offline.title: Check unavailable
alerts.absent.uptodate.msg: You are running the latest version: {version}.
alerts.absent.uptodate.title: Up to date
alerts.selector.hint: Select an alert to see the details. Sorted by decreasing severity.
alerts.update.hardDesc: Use only if the soft update is not enough (persistent issue). Purges everything: cache, maps, sessions, preferences.
alerts.update.softDesc: Only the app code is refreshed (HTML, JS, CSS, docs). Your maps, sessions and preferences are preserved.
config.display.intersections.hint: Filled colored circle where 2 paths cross (green × purple → yellow, etc.). Uncheck to declutter very dense maps, or if the computation slows down rendering. Immediate effect, saved per map (another map keeps its own setting).
config.display.intersections.label: ⚪ Show circles at intersections (this map)
config.display.north.hint: CW angle between the TOP of the map and true North. 0° = North up (default). If the North arrow points to the right of the map → 90°. Applied to the tracker (icon rotation + heading); the compass keeps showing true magnetic North independently.
config.display.north.label: 🧭 North calibration (this map)
config.display.scaledMarkers.hint: On by default: point icons shrink when you zoom out (constant size relative to the map). Uncheck = standard Leaflet behavior (fixed screen-size icons, they become huge when zoomed out). Reload required after changing.
config.display.scaledMarkers.label: 📐 Scale icon size with zoom
config.display.vibration.hint: Small vibration for confirmations (waypoint reached, action validated, alert). Uncheck = total silence (useful underground with other people, or for meditation). iOS Safari does not support the Web Vibration API — on iPhone, this toggle stays hidden. Global preference, kept across sessions.
config.display.vibration.label: 📳 Haptic vibration
config.display.voice.hint: Control the app by voice: zoom, center, search, add point, tracker on/off, emergency/rescue mode, light/dark theme… Push-to-talk via a floating 🎤 button bottom-right. Say “help” out loud to list the available commands. Microphone permission requested on first use. Reload required after changing (to inject/remove the button).
config.display.voice.label: 🎤 Voice commands (BETA)
config.display.wakelock.hint: Prevents the screen from sleeping while the app is open. Ideal underground so you don't have to unlock your phone every 30s. Persistent across sessions. The wake lock is auto-released when you switch tab/app, and re-enabled on return if the box is checked.
config.display.wakelock.label: 🔆 Keep screen on (Wake Lock)
config.georef.clickFloater: Click on the map to set Point {letter}
config.georef.errAllRequired: All fields are required (map x/y + GPS for A and B).
config.georef.errInvalidGps: Invalid GPS coordinates — fix the fields in red.
config.georef.intro: Calibrate the map by entering 2 reference points (map x/y coordinates + WGS84 GPS lat/lng). MyKTAMap computes the rotation+scale+translation transform to project all annotations onto the globe. The calibration is saved locally per map and automatically pre-filled when you open 📡 External export (KMZ / GPX) or import a GPX.
config.georef.okSaved: ✅ Calibration saved. Auto-filled in 📡 External export.
config.incognito.quit.desc:
Closes this incognito window. All accumulated data (points, tracker, notes) will be lost. Your main session stays intact in its own tab.
If the browser blocks the close, the tab automatically reloads in normal mode.
config.incognito.start.desc:
Opens a new window where no data is saved (no photos, no tracker, no preferences). Ideal for exploring a map in a public demo, lending your session to someone, or testing without polluting your local history. A visible purple border + a title badge remind you of the context.
On reload: everything is gone.
config.jonction.errSameLevel: Start and end levels must be different.
config.jonction.hint: After OK, click on the map to place the junction's points (as many as you want). The path will be dashed magenta and stay visible regardless of the active level.
config.jonction.intro: This junction (stairs, steep slope, internal shaft) links two levels.
config.lang.hint: Changes the language of the whole app (screens, menus, settings). The documentation and tutorial keep their own independent language choice.
config.mlvl.intro:
Enables level (floor) management for multi-floor quarries. Adds a level selector to the 🛣️ Paths group plus a 🪜 Inter-level junction sub-action. Existing roads with no explicit level are automatically treated as level 0.
Disabled by default — only for maps that need it (Glacière, Capucins, etc.).
config.mlvl.toggle.hint: Saved per map. Reload required for the UI changes to appear in the sidebar.
config.mlvl.toggle.label: 🏗️ Enable multi-level mode for this map
config.niveaux.active.hint: All new elements (paths, points, zones, repositioned tracker) will be tagged with this level.
config.niveaux.controlTitle: Active level — click to change / filter
config.niveaux.visible.hint: Check the levels you want to show on the map. Junctions are visible if at least one of their endpoints touches a checked level.
config.niveaux.warn: ⚠️ Changing the active level cancels any path in progress and resets the visible filter to [active].
config.perfultra.animOff.hint: Instant pan/zoom instead of animated. Reload required after changing.
config.perfultra.animOff.label: ⚡ Disable zoom/pan animations
config.perfultra.decim.hint: Simplifies polylines via Ramer-Douglas-Peucker. Paths look less smooth when zoomed out but render much faster.
config.perfultra.decim.label: 🪜 Decimate paths when zooming out
config.perfultra.intro: For large maps / weak devices. Enable 🚀 ULTRA to apply all optimizations at once, or tweak each lever individually. Changes apply on the fly — except options marked with an orange border, which require reloading the map to take effect.
config.perfultra.mobileZoomLimit.hint: Checked by default. On smartphones, caps the maximum zoom-out to avoid an OOM crash when Leaflet tries to render the whole image at minZoom. Unchecking allows the same max zoom-out as on PC (useful for an overview) but risks crashing on large maps. Reload required after changing.
config.perfultra.mobileZoomLimit.label: 🛡️ Limit zoom-out on mobile (memory crash guard)
config.perfultra.noIntersect.hint: Threshold lowered to 50 routes (vs 200 normally). No circles at crossroads beyond that.
config.perfultra.noIntersect.label: 🎯 Disable intersection circles (large maps)
config.perfultra.noTooltips.hint: No more popup when clicking markers on data layers. Session points stay interactive. Use 🔍 to interact.
config.perfultra.noTooltips.label: 🚫 Disable popups on data layers
config.perfultra.slowSave.hint: Auto-save every 30s instead of 1.5s. Risk of losing ~30s of changes on a crash.
config.perfultra.slowSave.label: 🐢 Slow auto-save (30s)
config.perfultra.ultra.hint: Preset that enables the 7 toggles below. Unchecking disables everything.
config.perfultra.ultra.label: 🚀 ULTRA mode (enables everything)
config.perfultra.viewportCull.hint: Skips routes AND POI markers outside the viewport. Slight pop-in when panning but a huge gain on dense maps (100+ POI).
config.perfultra.viewportCull.label: 👁️ Render only visible elements
config.presentation.desc: Hides the header + sidebars + footer to free up the whole surface for the map. Exit: <kbd>F</kbd> or <kbd>Esc</kbd> (PC), or the floating ✕ button top-right (mobile).
config.smartnav.hint: Off by default. When the map has a network of paths, the estimated position is snapped to the nearest gallery to offset sensor drift (compass / steps). Off-network, it automatically returns to the current behavior. Without paths on the map, the option has no effect.
config.smartnav.label: 🧭 Snap position to paths
config.steps.scaleTitle: Compute the scale from a real-world measurement
config.tracker.clickFloater: Click on the map for the tracker's initial position
denylist.modal.soustitre: This map was removed by the author or has leaked publicly.
denylist.purged.intro: The author added these maps to their public revocation list (leak, removal, etc.). They were removed from your list to prevent accidental use.
disttot.help: Uncheck the types to exclude from the calculation. Included paths are highlighted in magenta on the map. The highlight persists after closing the modal — click ❌ Clear to remove it.
disttot.noRoads:
No path drawn on this map.

Draw at least one path (Main / Secondary / Trail) before computing a total distance.
editor.err.photoQuotaDisk: Browser storage is full. Delete unused photos or plans.
editor.err.photoQuotaPoint: Maximum of 5 photos per point reached.
editor.err.tagChars: The tag may only contain letters, digits, _ or -
editor.field.name: Name
editor.field.newTagHint: The default icon will be used. To customise the icon, edit the plan via 📦.
editor.photos.empty: No photos. Add one with the buttons below.
editor.photos.hint: JPEG/PNG, automatically compressed (1920px max, 85% quality). Max 5 photos per point.
editor.photos.maxReached: Maximum of {max} photos per point reached
fav.toast.storageFull: Storage full — favorites not saved. Remember to export your session.
filter.levels.mono: Single-level map — this filter is disabled.

gen.calib.chargeImageDabord: Load a main image first (to get the map dimensions).
gen.calib.enregistree: ✅ Calibration saved (will be embedded in the ZIP)
gen.calib.hintChoisir: ⏳ Choose an image file to analyze its dimensions…
gen.calib.hintPlanPasCharge: ⏳ Main map not loaded yet (load the main image first).
gen.calib.warn: ⚠️ Calibrate ONLY if the layer dimensions differ from the main map — otherwise you would break the alignment.
gen.dataLayers.editorInfo: The editor layer is always included automatically.
gen.dataLayers.importHint: You can grab in one go the layers (points / paths / zones / structures) + photos from a data-layer ZIP exported from the app via 💾 Save session → 🔄 Conversion → ✏️→🗂️ Session to data layer.
gen.dataLayers.importTitre: 📦 Import a data-layer ZIP in one click
gen.dim.illisible: Unable to read the image dimensions — corrupted file or unsupported format.
gen.dim.warnGrande: 🚨 Large dimension detected ({w} × {h} px, > {lim} px). Risk of memory crash on mobile. Consider choosing a low performance mode, or reducing the image before import.
gen.dim.warnGros: 🚨 Large file detected ({mo} MB, > {lim} MB). The final ZIP will be heavy. Prefer JPEG quality 85 over PNG, or crop the image to save space.
gen.gen.dimInconnues: Map dimensions unknown — load or reload the main image (decoding failed).
gen.gen.fichierImgIntrouvable: Image file "{fichier}" not found in the source ZIP. Re-upload the file via the 📂 Choose button of layer "{id}".
gen.gen.idManquantData: Missing identifier on a data layer.
gen.gen.idManquantImg: Missing identifier on an image layer.
gen.gen.v2ImageIntrouvableMsg: Choose a main image first (🖼️ Main images section).
gen.gen.v2OOMSuffix: This is typical on mobile for images > 50 MB or > 8K px. Solutions: generate on a PC, or reduce the source image.
gen.geo.formatInvalide: GPS coordinates {label}: invalid format (expected « lat, lng » between [-90,90] and [-180,180])
gen.georef.info: Embeds a 2-point calibration in the generated map. The app can then export to geolocated KMZ / GPX (Google Earth, OsmAnd, Strava…) or re-import an external GPX without re-entering anything. Leave empty if you don't have the GPS coordinates — fully backward-compatible.
gen.gpx.analyseOk: ✅ GPX analyzed — configure below then Generate the ZIP
gen.gpx.calibrageAutoVal: BL corner = (lat_min, lng_min), TR corner = (lat_max, lng_max)
gen.gpx.canvasInfo: Blank canvas — a solid background is generated at the chosen dimensions. GPS calibration is automatic (GPX bounds). You can replace this canvas with a real map image afterwards via 🏗️ Generate a map → Edit.
gen.gpx.dropLabel: Drop a .gpx here or click to select
gen.gpx.intro: Select a .gpx file previously exported by MyKTAMap (📡 External export → GPX tab). The app generates a usable MyKTAMap ZIP with a blank canvas automatically calibrated on the GPX's GPS bounds — you can replace the canvas with a real map image afterwards in « Edit the map » mode.
gen.gpx.mlvlHint: Enables level management in the generated plan-config.json. Tick if your MyKTAMap GPX contained multi-level annotations (preserved via <cmt>MyKTAMap level=N</cmt>).
gen.gpx.noCoords: ❌ No valid GPS coordinate in this GPX
gen.gpx.roundtrip: ℹ️ MyKTAMap round-trip — a GPX exported from MyKTAMap keeps point tags (via <sym>), path types (<type>) and multi-level levels (<cmt>MyKTAMap level=N</cmt>) — all restored on re-import.
gen.gpx.sourceMkm: ✅ MyKTAMap GPX detected — full round-trip (tags, multi-level levels preserved)
gen.gpx.sourceTiers: ⚠️ Third-party GPX (TopoDroid / OsmAnd / Strava…) — default types applied to waypoints/tracks without a recognized <sym> or <type>
gen.gpx.typesInfo: Default types — fallback for waypoints / tracks without a recognized <sym> / <type>. MyKTAMap GPX files encode the tag/type directly and are restored as-is.
gen.gpx.v2Hint: Re-tiles the blank canvas into 512×512 tiles. Only useful if you plan to replace the canvas with a large image afterwards. For an empty canvas, V1 is more than enough.
gen.gpx.v2RowTitle: Cuts the canvas into 512x512 tiles across 4 zoom levels. Massive memory reduction on large maps.
gen.gpx.zipGenere: ✅ ZIP generated! {kept} annotations imported, {oob} out-of-bounds ignored, {skipped} skipped.
gen.histoire.info: PDF that tells the story of the site (origins, archive maps, anecdotes…). Bundled in the map ZIP, read by History Mode (📖 modal in the status bar). 100% offline reading, never sent to the server.
gen.histoire.modifierHint: In Edit mode, any existing PDF is kept unless you choose a new file OR click 🗑 Remove.
gen.icons.info: Each tag defines a clickable point type in add mode. The default and track tags are always included.
gen.icons.svgTitle: SVG icon built into the application
gen.icons.videApresSuppr: No icon — click + Add a tag
gen.icons.videHint: Click "↺ Load defaults" or "+ Add a tag"
gen.imp.legendeDetectee: ✅ Custom map legend detected: {parts} (restored when the rebuilt map boots)
gen.importZip.noJSZip: JSZip not loaded — cannot read a ZIP.
gen.importZip.noJson: Invalid ZIP: no .json data-layer file found at the root.
gen.importZip.vide: Empty data-layer ZIP: no point/path/zone/structure found.
gen.infos.dimAttente: Dimensions: waiting for the main image below to load
gen.kmz.dropLabel: Drop a .kmz here or click to select
gen.kmz.intro: Select a .kmz file previously exported by MyKTAMap (🌍 KMZ tab of the session export). The app re-imports it as a usable MyKTAMap ZIP.
gen.kmz.mgWarn: ⚠️ {n} MultiGeometry detected — skipped in Phase 1 MVP (Phase 2 will split them).
gen.kmz.mlvlHint: Enables level management (Lvl 0, 1, 2…) + inter-level junctions in the generated plan-config.json. Only tick if the original map was multi-level and you will re-enter / re-import the levels afterwards.
gen.kmz.overlaysExtra: ⚠️ {n} other GroundOverlay(s) ignored in MVP (1st taken as baseImage).
gen.kmz.phase1: ⚠️ Phase 1 (since v173) — only KMZ files exported from MyKTAMap are supported for now. Third-party KMZ files (Google Earth, OsmAnd, IGN scan…) will show an incompatibility message.
gen.kmz.pret: ✅ Ready to import — choose the default types then generate.
gen.kmz.sansImage: ❌ MyKTAMap KMZ without a map image (export without GroundOverlay)
gen.kmz.typesInfo: Default types — fallback for Placemarks without a recognized styleUrl. KMZ files exported from MyKTAMap encode the tag/type directly (#point_<tag>, #road_<type>, #zone_<type>, #structure_<subtype>) and are restored as-is — the choices below only apply to orphan Placemarks (e.g. third-party KMZ from Google Earth / OsmAnd / IGN scan).
gen.kmz.v2Hint: Regenerates tiles from the KMZ's flat image — useful if the original map was V2 and you want the smooth mobile rendering back. Heavy generation (1-5 minutes depending on size). Recommended on a PC.
gen.kmz.v2RowTitle: Cuts the KMZ's flat image into 512x512 tiles across 4 zoom levels. Massive memory reduction on large maps (>50 MB).
gen.kmzIncompat.aide:
💡 To use this feature:
· Export a MyKTAMap map to KMZ via 💾 Session export → 🌍 KMZ
· The generated KMZ contains the signature that allows re-importing it here
· Support for third-party KMZ (Google Earth, OsmAnd…) is planned for a future version
gen.kmzIncompat.titre: 🚫 This KMZ file is not compatible for now
gen.kmzIncompat.txt: This KMZ does not contain the MyKTAMap signature that allows importing in this version (Phase 1 MVP). It was probably created by another tool (Google Earth, OsmAnd, Locus, Avenza, IGN scan, etc.).
gen.kmzNoImg.solutions:
💡 Solutions:
· If you have a scanned image of the map, create the map first via 🏗️ Create a map, then you can add the annotations by hand
· If the KMZ comes from MyKTAMap, check that it was exported with the 🖼️ Map image option ticked
· A future version may allow manual calibration (provide image + 4 GPS corners) for this case
gen.kmzNoImg.txt1: This KMZ file does not contain a GroundOverlay (georeferenced map image). It was probably created for OSM/satellite mapping (waypoints, GPS tracks) without a custom background image.
gen.kmzNoImg.txt2: MyKTAMap needs a map image (PNG/JPEG) to position annotations. Without an image, there is no pixel coordinate system to use.
gen.layer.label: Label
gen.legende.info: Customization applied to ALL users who load this map (renames, hides, drawable custom entries). The user can always override their own session on top (cascade session > map > default).
gen.legende.resetConfirm:
Clear the map legend customization?

The cascade will revert to the MKM default.
gen.mlvl.hint: Enables level management (Lvl 0, 1, 2…) + inter-level junctions. Only tick for quarries/galleries with several stacked levels.
gen.mlvl.label: 🏗️ Multi-level map (advanced)
gen.mode.avanceHint: ⚙️ Advanced mode: all options (image + data layers, tracking, custom icons, GPS georeferencing, map-level legend).
gen.mode.simpleHint: 🚀 Simple mode: just the bare essentials (image + name + version + V2/multi-level). Default icons are loaded automatically.
gen.photos.hint: Bundles the current map's local photos into data/photos/ of the generated ZIP. Visible only in Edit mode (photos are linked to the currently loaded map).
gen.photos.label: 📸 Include attached photos
gen.photos.rowTitle: Bundles the photos attached to points into the generated map ZIP (data/photos/). Lets you share the map with its photos to another device.
gen.router.badExt: ❌ The file must be a .zip, a .kmz or a .gpx
gen.tracking.nordExplain: 🧭 North: leave 0 if the top of the map = true North (standard case). For maps whose North is elsewhere (skewed aerial photo, cataphile map without an aligned compass rose), enter the CW angle between the top of the map and true North. Effect: tracker (rotation + walking direction) + compass. The end user can override this setting per map via ⚙️ Settings.
gen.tracking.recentrerErr: Load the main image first — without dimensions, the center cannot be computed.
gen.tracking.recentrerTitle: Resets the start position to the map center (W/2 × H/2)
gen.v2.hint: Generates 512x512 tiles across 4 zoom levels. Massive memory reduction on large maps (>50 MB). Available only in Edit an existing map mode.
gen.v2.label: 🧱 Convert to V2 tiles (performance)
gen.v2.rowTitle: Cuts the image into 512x512 tiles across 4 zoom levels. Massive memory reduction on large maps.
gen.v2err.consJpeg: Convert to JPEG quality 85 if your source is PNG: 5 to 10× smaller in size with no visible loss.
gen.v2err.consPC: Generate on a PC rather than mobile — no practical memory ceiling, the generated V2 ZIP will then import at no cost on your phone.
gen.v2err.consReduire: Reduce the source image before retrying: resize to 6000-8000 px max via GIMP / Photoshop / Squoosh. You lose a little detail at max zoom but the conversion goes through.
gen.v2prog.titre: Conversion to V2 tiles: generating tiles…
gen.v2prog.warn: ⚠️ Do not close the tab during conversion. On mobile, the browser may kill the page if memory saturates.
gen.v2warn.cpu: CPU: you decode the source image at full resolution then draw each tile (up to 1000+ tiles depending on the map size).
gen.v2warn.duree: Duration: 1 to 5 minutes depending on the image size and hardware.
gen.v2warn.lead: V2 conversion (tile generation) is a heavy operation:
gen.v2warn.mobileTxt: iOS Safari and Android Chrome cap the PWA at ~500 MB of RAM. Source image >50 MB or >8K px: crash almost guaranteed during generation.
gen.v2warn.note: 💡 Once the V2 ZIP is generated on a PC, you import it on your phone at no memory cost — that's exactly the point of V2.
gen.v2warn.pcTxt: No particular limit (plenty of memory). This is the recommended method to generate your V2 map before distributing it or importing it on mobile.
gen.v2warn.ram: Browser RAM: the decoded source image takes ~ W×H×4 bytes (~256 MB for an 8000×8000 px).
gen.vierge.info: The app generates an empty PNG canvas at the chosen dimensions, with the selected background color. Useful to draw a map from scratch (pillars, working faces, paths) without a source image.
gen.vierge.limites: Limits: 500 px min, 12000 px max (anti memory-crash on mobile).
gen.zip.dropLabel: Drop a ZIP, KMZ or GPX here or click to select
gen.zip.exempleTitle: Download a sample ZIP to edit
gen.zip.info: 3 accepted formats: MyKTAMap ZIP (edit an existing map), MyKTAMap KMZ (External export → automatically reconverted with map image + icons + annotations) or MyKTAMap GPX (waypoints + tracks → blank canvas auto-calibrated on the GPS bounds + annotations). Otherwise, just fill in the form to create a new map from scratch.
gen.zipModif.noPlanConfig: plan-config.json not found in the ZIP
gen.zipModif.revoque: ⛔ ZIP revoked by the author — editing refused.
heatmap.data.toggleAllTitle: Check / uncheck all 4 data layer sources
heatmap.levels.note: Combined with the sources above. An inter-level junction is included if AT LEAST one of its 2 levels is checked.
heatmap.modal.help: Shows where the density of elements is highest. Paths and tracker are interpolated along their segments (continuous trails, not isolated points). The densest pixel = red, the least dense = blue — the coloring auto-adapts to the selected data.
heatmap.toast.noData: 🔥 No data for the heatmap. Enable a source (tracker, points, paths, layers).
heatmap.toast.tooMany: 🔥 Too many elements for the heatmap ({count} > {max}). Uncheck sources to reduce the load.
home.add.drop: Drop your ZIP archive, a KMZ or a GPX MyKTAMap here
home.add.fsInfo: On Chrome/Edge, allow once and the app will be able to reopen this ZIP in 1 click.
home.add.storeInfo: The ZIP will be copied into the browser's local storage and reloaded in 1 click. Recommended on mobile.
home.add.storeLabel: 💾 Remember this map in the app
home.add.title: 📦 Add a map
home.debug.hint: The toggle enables the verbose console (tracker, fetch, etc.). The 📋 button shows the captured logs directly (also useful with no map loaded).
home.debug.title: 🛠️ Debug
home.footer.proEdition: © 2026 MyKTAMap — pro edition · All rights reserved
home.header.lock: Lock the app (code required to resume)
home.inspector.intro: A readable overview of what is currently loaded in memory on the browser side: localStorage, IndexedDB, PWA cache, runtime state. Useful to understand usage and diagnose an issue.
home.inspector.title: 📊 Inspector
home.lang.label: Application language
home.osm.title: 🌍 OSM View
home.perf.decimHint: Simplifies polylines. Less smooth tracks but faster.
home.perf.masterHint: Preset: enables the 7 optimisations below all at once.
home.perf.mobileZoomHint: Checked by default. Caps the maximum zoom-out on smartphones to avoid OOM crashes. Uncheck = allows the same zoom-out as on PC (overview) but risks crashing on large maps. Reload required.
home.perf.noIntersectHint: Threshold 50 routes (vs 200). No circles at junctions beyond that.
home.perf.noTooltipsHint: Session points stay interactive. Use 🔍 for the data layers.
home.perf.slowSaveHint: Saves every 30s instead of 1.5s. Risk of losing ~30s of edits on a crash.
home.perf.ultraIntro: For large maps that crash. Does NOT affect the image (already handled by the tiling above). Global preference, kept across sessions.
home.perf.ultraMasterTitle: Enables the 7 toggles below all at once
home.perf.viewportCullHint: Slight pop-in when panning, big gain on dense maps.
home.plans.title: 📚 My maps
home.privacy.badgeTitle: Click to open the configuration and disable it
home.privacy.incognitoQuitHint:
Closes this incognito window. All accumulated data (points, tracker, notes) will be lost. Your main session stays intact in its tab.
If the browser blocks the close, the tab automatically reloads in normal mode.
home.privacy.incognitoStartHint:
Opens a new window where no data is saved (no photos, no tracker, no preferences). Ideal for exploring a map in a public demo, lending your session to someone else, or testing without polluting your local history. A purple border + a badge in the title are reminders of the context.
On reload: everything is gone.
home.privacy.intro: MyKTAMap is 100% client-side: none of your data is sent to a server. You can verify it yourself.
home.privacy.netDocBtn: 📖 What does the app do on the network?
home.privacy.osmToggle: 🗺️ Allow OSM View (OpenStreetMap) — enables the "map over OSM" mode for GPS-calibrated maps. Contacts tile.openstreetmap.org when the OSM View modal is open. Persisted preference (default OFF).
home.privacy.strictToggle: 🔒 Strict offline mode — actively blocks any non-whitelisted outgoing request (the app stays 100% functional offline). Persisted preference.
home.privacy.title: 🔒 Privacy & Audit
imgcal.preview: 👁️ Preview — The image is calibrated. If the alignment is OK, click ✅ Validate. Otherwise ↺ Restart.
imgcal.step1: 🔴 Step 1/4 — Click point A on the image layer (left): a recognizable spot (corner, intersection, marker).
imgcal.step2: 🔴 Step 2/4 — Click the same point A on the main map (right).
imgcal.step3: 🔵 Step 3/4 — Click point B on the image layer (left). Choose it far from point A for better accuracy.
imgcal.step4: 🔵 Step 4/4 — Click the same point B on the main map (right).
imgcal.warn.collinear: ⚠️ Anchors too close or collinear — restart with points farther apart.
imgcal.warn.noPlugin: ⚠️ Missing plugin or helper — preview unavailable. You can still validate.
incognito.badge.label: 🕵️ INCOGNITO
incognito.badge.tooltip: Incognito mode active — no data is saved
incognito.confirm.changes.b1: No data is saved on your device (points, tracks, zones, photos, tracker, theme/language preferences…).
incognito.confirm.changes.b2: A new window opens with the ?incognito=1 parameter.

maint.cleaning_text: Deleting all local storage + unregistering the Service Worker.
